snippets.instruction: Store numbers in a fixed array with a counter
Use a fixed-capacity dynamic array instead
targets:
package main

MAX_NUMBERS :: 4096
numbers: [dynamic; MAX_NUMBERS]int

main :: proc() {
	append(&numbers, 7)
	append(&numbers, 5)
	append(&numbers, 42)

	unordered_remove(&numbers, 1)

	fmt.println(numbers)
}
